description: A squat chrome machine bolted to the back bar, hissing gently to itself between orders. A spring-loaded tube of paper cups is clamped to its flank, so nobody has to ask anybody for one. The drip tray hasn't been emptied since anyone can remember.

flags.vend_line: The tube clunks and drops a paper cup into your hand, still warm from the machine it lives against.

name: espresso rig
